findings.title: Off-by-one in the pagination cursor
findings.description: The cursor is advanced before the boundary check, dropping the last page's first row.
findings.suggestion: Advance the cursor after the boundary check.

findings.title: N+1 query in the hot loop
findings.description: Each iteration re-queries the same table instead of batching.
findings.suggestion: Batch the lookup outside the loop.
